name: intro-loader.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  intro-loader.scss — the boot loader overlay, same visual language as the
//  experiments' loaders (star-field / docs): fixed dark veil with a radial
//  glow, spinning ring, big percent counter, brand title, a localized stage
//  readout, and a thin progress bar. Lifts away once boot finishes.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

$_B_LOADER: 'intro-loader';

@keyframes intro-loader-spin-cw {
  to {
    rotate: 360deg;
  }
}

@keyframes intro-loader-spin-ccw {
  to {
    rotate: -360deg;
  }
}

// Fullscreen dark veil over the whole boot — z-index 100000 sits above every
// layer including dialogs. The exit transition fades + scales 1→1.05: the
// overlay appears to lift toward the viewer as it dissolves (ease-out-quart
// curve: fast start, soft landing).
.#{$_B_LOADER} {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  height: 100dvh;
  background: var(--bg-darkest);
  z-index: 100000;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
  pointer-events: auto;

  // Exit state — applied once boot finishes; pointer-events:none so the page
  // is interactive the instant the veil starts fading, not after.
  &--hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.05);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  // Radial glow behind the content — same treatment as the experiment
  // loaders: a dim electric halo sinking into the dark.
  &-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
      circle at center,
      rgba($color-blue, 0.35) 0%,
      rgba($color-black, 0.9) 60%,
      rgba($color-black, 1) 100%
    );
  }

  // Blueprint grid behind the content — same treatment as the experiment
  // loaders: faint orthogonal lines fading out under a radial mask.
  &-grid {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(to right, rgba($color-white, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba($color-white, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
      ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%,
      var(--bg-dark) 70%,
      transparent 100%
    );
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%, var(--bg-dark) 70%, transparent 100%);
  }

  &-content {
    position: relative;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  // Outer orbital ring — clockwise, orbiting the counter like the
  // experiment loaders' sp/sf spinners.
  &-spinner {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    height: to-rem($space-8xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: 1px solid rgba($color-white, 0.1);
    border-top-color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
    border-right-color: rgba($color-white, 0.3);
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-left-color: transparent;
    animation: intro-loader-spin-cw 8s linear infinite;
  }

  // Inner counter-rotating ring — slower, wider, dimmer; same orbit as the
  // outer ring so both spin around the percent counter.
  &-spinner-inner {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    width: to-rem($space-9xl);
    height: to-rem($space-9xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: 1px solid rgba($color-white, 0.05);
    border-bottom-color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    animation: intro-loader-spin-ccw 12s linear infinite;
  }

  // Counter box centered under the orbiting rings — same 4xl footprint the
  // experiment loaders use so both rings visually orbit the numeral.
  &-counter {
    width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    height: to-rem($space-4xl);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  // The boot percentage — HUD numeral inside the rings; tabular-nums keeps
  // digits fixed-width so the counter doesn't jitter as it climbs.
  &-percent {
    @extend %TTL_MD;

    font-weight: 300;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.9);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  // Brand line under the counter — same register as the experiment titles.
  &-title {
    @extend %TTL_XS;

    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xs);
  }

  // Localized boot-stage readout under the title.
  &-msg {
    @extend %TXT_XS;

    font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    line-height: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  // Thin progress bar under the stage line.
  &-bar {
    width: to-rem($space-10xl);
    height: to-rem($space-2xs);
    margin-top: to-rem($space-xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    background: rgba($color-white, 0.12);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  &-bar-fill {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    background: rgba($color-white, 0.85);
    // rAF-driven scaleX — transform stays on the compositor, a width
    // transition would re-layout the fill every frame.
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
